title: A camera's seen file: the facts its looks established that the coverage ledger's public form carries
description: data/<model>_fw<fw>/seen_<model>_fw<fw>.json, written by kit/tools/coverage.py --write where the mapper's looks file is (the committed facts with the looks' own, a retraction of the looks taking a committed one out), never by hand: the one part of the public form no public source gives (docs/decisions/0023). Only what a look establishes that holds for every camera of the model (camkit.coverage.ALLOWED): a row that opens an information screen, with the kit's address field names it showed; a row that acts when opened; a row, and the values of its settings, a hand check saw change a record; a row of the maker's Save/Load list seen to change nothing. Never a run, a date, a state seen, a field that is not one of safety.ADDRESS_FIELDS' names, or a value other than a setting's own code (docs/decisions/0016): kit/tools/check_public.py refuses one that breaks this schema or holds a word its camera's public sources do not know, and refuses a public form that is not the build of the public sources and this file.

about.description: What the file is, in words: the kit's own (camkit.coverage.SEEN_ABOUT).

facts.description: One fact per kind and row, in the ledger's row order.

kind.description: info: the row opens an information screen; acted: it acts when opened; hand_changed: a hand check saw it change a record; confirmed: a row of the maker's Save/Load list seen to change nothing.

path.description: The row's labels from its top row down, as the public sources write them.

nth.description: A label the menu repeats in a tab: the second (1), third (2) ... of them.

fields.description: An information screen's field names: the kit's address field names (safety.ADDRESS_FIELDS) alone, never a value.

values.description: A hand check's values, by setting key: the codes of the values it saw change a record.
